status: Approved design labels for future content; production IDs retained.

regions.name: Thornford Reach
regions.biome: Temperate farms, hedges and a wooded road
regions.reason: Thorn and ford suggest hedged country and a river crossing; Reach names the district.

regions.name: Rillbank Vale
regions.biome: River valley, mills and freight landings
regions.reason: Keep Rillbank as the town; Vale makes the wider geography distinct from its quays.

regions.name: Mirefen
regions.biome: Wetland, peat, reeds and raised paths
regions.reason: The name already signals wet ground; the hubs show how people work around it.

regions.name: Paleweald
regions.biome: Haunted woodland and sheltered archive settlements
regions.reason: Pale suggests the drained woodland palette; the woodland name fits roots, trees and old tracks.

regions.name: Brinewatch Strand
regions.biome: Salt coast, cliffs, beaches and working harbors
regions.reason: Brine suggests the sea; Strand describes the wider shoreline while Brinewatch remains the port.

regions.name: Highmere Downs
regions.biome: Rolling uplands, grazing, quarries and small high waters
regions.reason: Highmere and Downs suit inhabited upland country rather than a second volcanic frontier.

regions.name: Cinder Reach
regions.biome: Ash country, lava-cut rock and industrial work camps
regions.reason: Cinder immediately suggests heat and ash. The human settlements add their own identities.

regions.name: Frostward Marches
regions.biome: Snowbound borderlands, passes and sheltered settlements
regions.reason: Frost cues the climate; Marches suggests a frontier of watch posts and supply roads.

regions.name: Sunscar Basin
regions.biome: Sun-baked desert, salt roads, dunes and oasis settlements
regions.reason: Sunscar suggests heat and weathered ground. Sable Well becomes the oasis town, not the name of an entire desert.

hub_changes.name: Willow Ferry
hub_changes.reason: A river landmark is more memorable than a direction.

hub_changes.name: Scribes’ Hollow
hub_changes.reason: Keeps the archive identity while giving the settlement woodland geography.

hub_changes.name: Heatherpass Relay
hub_changes.reason: Heather ties this pass to the uplands rather than any generic high road.

hub_changes.name: Redkiln Camp
hub_changes.reason: A distinctive working name for the hot inner frontier.

hub_changes.name: Rimepass
hub_changes.reason: The cold pass gains an immediate climate cue and avoids confusion with Lantern Crossing.

hub_changes.name: Sable Well
hub_changes.reason: Retains the established oasis name as a settlement inside Sunscar Basin.

hub_changes.name: Duneshade Rest
hub_changes.reason: A desert rest stop with an understandable reason to exist.

hub_changes.name: Glassroad Station
hub_changes.reason: A compact proper name for the desert approach.

hub_changes.name: Rimewatch Gate
hub_changes.reason: The northern final approach gets a geographical name; the institution is described in its story.

policy: Use a geographical region name, a human settlement name and a specific landmark name at different scales.
A place name may convey climate, terrain, local work or history; it need not literally name the biome.
Keep existing current-map IDs and saved quest identities.
Use shorter local labels on the minimap, with region context in the map and journal.
